decisions.reason: As a low-cost, high-uncertainty ecosystem play that is still prominently featured, the accelerator is worth keeping open for learning, partnerships, and future option value despite being less central to the firm's core machinery business.

Because the bio-based CO2-negative binder remains a flagship with its own page and fits the firm's circular-economy innovation story, management would likely continue backing it while market and technical uncertainty resolve further.

The decontamination plant is strongly aligned with the firm's modular waste-treatment capabilities and is still highlighted on the home page, so the option value of staying in this niche appears higher than the cost of keeping it on the market.
